description: This file defines the TextFragment class and related classes for handling text segments, including indexing, comparison, and iteration functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with indexing, comparison, and manipulation capabilities.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments of a TextFragment based on delimiters.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Helper class within TextFragment for managing segment indices.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for TextFragment.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a character at a specific index within the TextFragment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between TextFragments, strings, or character arrays.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between TextFragments, strings, or character arrays.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment is on a given marker.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TextFragment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer of the TextFragment.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the TextFragment as a std::string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares TextFragments for equality, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a delimiter character or string starting from an offset.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips forward over characters not in the delimiter set.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims characters from the beginning based on delimiters.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims characters from the end based on delimiters.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a delimiter character or string.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backward over characters in the delimiter set.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next segment.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current TextFragment in the iterator.

methods.name: Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining TextFragment from the current position.
